knowledge.name: Client and portfolio context
knowledge.detail: Dynamics 365 context links client objectives and review roles to the approved portfolio record without making suitability decisions.

knowledge.name: Allocation and policy snapshot
knowledge.detail: Current holdings, target weights, benchmarks, rebalance cadence, and drift thresholds form the governed analysis baseline.

knowledge.name: Tax-lot and cost-basis evidence
knowledge.detail: Approved accounting data supplies values and cost basis for illustrative tax and loss-candidate review by qualified professionals.

knowledge.name: Planning assumptions and controls
knowledge.detail: Retirement inputs, tax assumptions, wash-sale checks, suitability rules, and authorization boundaries remain explicit and reviewable.

intelligence_processing.name: Drift threshold detection
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares current and target allocations, calculates each gap, and identifies portfolios that meet configured review thresholds.

intelligence_processing.name: Rebalancing candidate construction
intelligence_processing.detail: Translates threshold breaches into nonbinding increase and reduction candidates for licensed-advisor and client review.

intelligence_processing.name: Illustrative tax impact
intelligence_processing.detail: Estimates gain-related tax exposure from fixed assumptions and presents validation questions rather than individualized tax advice.

intelligence_processing.name: Loss-candidate screening
intelligence_processing.detail: Surfaces unrealized-loss positions while requiring tax-lot, holding-period, account-type, wash-sale, and suitability checks.

intelligence_processing.name: Retirement scenario framing
intelligence_processing.detail: Frames horizon, withdrawal, return, volatility, inflation, fee, tax, and longevity inputs without asserting success probability.

intelligence_processing.name: Controlled implementation sequencing
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds a review, cash, settlement, approval, and verification checklist; it never creates, routes, or executes an order.

clients_user_interface.name: Advisor Copilot workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Microsoft 365 Copilot or Copilot Studio gives advisors a conversational view of drift, candidates, assumptions, and controls.

clients_user_interface.name: Portfolio manager review
clients_user_interface.detail: Portfolio managers inspect concentration, allocation gaps, thresholds, and candidate changes before client discussion or action.

clients_user_interface.name: Paraplanner and tax review
clients_user_interface.detail: Specialists review scenario inputs, illustrative estimates, tax-loss candidates, and missing professional validations.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams approval collaboration
clients_user_interface.detail: Microsoft Teams supports licensed-advisor, compliance, and authorized-trading review without exposing trade execution.

management_reporting.name: Power BI drift reporting
management_reporting.detail: Power BI visualizes allocation gaps, threshold status, and review queues using approved portfolio evidence.

management_reporting.name: Client review presentation
management_reporting.detail: PowerPoint-ready summaries explain candidate changes, assumptions, scenarios, and unresolved controls for advisor-led meetings.

management_reporting.name: Compliance review record
management_reporting.detail: Review outputs document synthetic provenance, tax and suitability caveats, required approvers, and the no-transaction boundary.

management_reporting.name: Validation evidence dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Locked persona cases and draft-state evidence report deterministic coverage, safety assertions, and publication readiness.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the advisor-facing draft agent, six governed operations, two knowledge files, and prepublication validation.

tools.name: Dynamics 365
tools.detail: Provides approved wealth-management client context while leaving suitability and advice decisions with licensed professionals.

tools.name: Portfolio accounting and tax-lot service
tools.detail: Supplies authorized holdings, targets, values, and cost basis for drift and illustrative tax analysis.

tools.name: Financial planning system
tools.detail: Receives advisor-validated retirement assumptions for scenario modeling outside the agent's fixed demonstration data.

tools.name: Power BI
tools.detail: Presents portfolio drift, review status, and governed reporting views from approved data sources.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Coordinates human approvals among advisors, compliance reviewers, and authorized trading personnel before external action.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence
supporting_features.detail: Fictional portfolios and deterministic outputs enable safe demonstrations without live client or market data.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic operation routing
supporting_features.detail: Six persona-language cases map to the expected PortfolioRebalancingAgent operation under strict tool isolation.

supporting_features.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
supporting_features.detail: The validated Copilot Studio draft uses Claude Sonnet 4.6 while preserving operation and safety instructions.

supporting_features.name: Least-privilege connections
supporting_features.detail: Only approved connector references may be bound, with production data and external actions excluded from demonstration.

supporting_features.name: Advisor and specialist review
supporting_features.detail: Licensed advisors, qualified tax professionals, compliance, clients, and authorized traders retain consequential decisions.

supporting_features.name: No advice or trade execution
supporting_features.detail: Outputs are review candidates only; the agent gives no investment or tax advice and creates, routes, or executes no order.

supporting_features.name: Draft publication gate
supporting_features.detail: All six locked cases must pass with safety boundaries intact, and explicit confirmation is required before publication.
